world: Two fixed nonlinear 8-to-32-tanh-to-4 teacher functions occupy disjoint observable input regions. Common x0 is -1-0.5*abs(N(0,1)); rare x0 is +1+0.5*abs(N(0,1)). The other seven common coordinates shift among four means of scale three every 128 batches; rare coordinates stay N(0,1). The first 512 batches use the zero common mean and half rare examples so rare information can first be learned. Later rare probability is 1/512 while common shifts continue. The conditional input/output law stays fixed; only its observation frequencies change. No oracle region flag reaches a learner. Targets include independent Gaussian noise 0.03. World, schedule, observation and held-out probe RNGs are separate and prefix stable.
learner: Use unchanged E6 GuardedSharing with merging on or off and unchanged context replay. E1/E2/E6 parameters are inherited except the declared module cap of two to stress consolidation at bounded capacity. Two modules can represent the two observable regions; this does not guarantee the learned router selects them. Source and temporary neural state, optimizers and reservoir persist through all updates. The existing 128-anchor mean-MSE merge tolerance max(0.005,0.2*old) is unchanged. No compression fix is installed.
audit: At each existing E6 anchor check, hold Python references to the pre-update persistent models, then let the unchanged learner finish its actual decision. Evaluate the outgoing source and proposed replacement on disjoint common and rare probe sets; the old model is frozen during the temporary-adaptation merge path. Match the recorded source/candidate choice to the event. Audit predictions never enter training, selection, routing, acceptance or reservoir. Record every check, including rejections and sources that were never competent. A material erased-competence event requires old rare MSE <= 0.05 and replacement rare MSE > max(0.05,2*old rare MSE), plus actual acceptance for an erased-memory claim. A proposal failure without acceptance is not memory erasure. The outgoing model is released after auditing and is not a hidden archive available to the learner.
retention: Every 512 updates, score operational common and rare predictions without observing their outputs. Also score each persistent module directly as a labeled best-module diagnostic to distinguish absent competence from selection failure; it is never supplied as an operational capability. Report acquisition, subsequent rare error, prequential error, all material merge losses and bounded-capacity hits. If rare competence is never acquired or no relevant merges occur, say the intended failure could not be measured rather than claiming preservation.
preflight: Use separate dummy worlds to exercise at least one accepted merge. Verify audited and unaudited learners have exactly equal predictions, final model weights, anchors, optimizer counters and torch RNG states. Verify the outgoing model is unchanged on a check step, source/candidate mapping is valid, probe evaluation does not consume RNG and checkpoint restore yields identical read-only predictions. Verify generated prefixes and hidden audit metadata are never learner inputs.
costs: Charge operational learner forwards, training examples, all local replay, routing, merge checks, parameters, optimizer state and anchor buffers through inherited counters. Record audit forward examples and audit seconds separately from operational loop time and include their sum as study execution cost. Audit storage includes probe tensors and the transient outgoing model reference; this is research overhead, not agent capability. Inherited tracked tensor peak is not full process RAM. Record serialized checkpoint size, data generation and total learner-loop wall time. Full process RAM, energy and complete FLOPs remain unmeasured. Each run has 262144 real observations; paired arms reuse the same acquired stream.
scope: This is an adversarial audit of an already implemented compression/merging claim, not a new general reasoning or semantic-memory benchmark. Rare continuous function answers proxy retained information, not exact language facts. TTT-E2E's supplied needle-retrieval result motivates separating predictive averages from rare recall; AdaMM/OaK motivate testing distinctions outside the stored schema/sample. A failure localizes a real problem; passing finitely many probes cannot certify arbitrary future queries. A later memory repair must be separately frozen and compared at complete storage/access cost.
